name: Siddha Ventures Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Siddha Ventures Ltd is in the business of trading in shares.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SVL is a Kolkata-based company that is engaged in the business of share trading, investment, and broking activities. The co. mainly does investments and trading in the quoted and unquoted equities, broking or sub-broking.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.40 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -2.24% over last 3 years.
